name: Safa
summary: A single fluid drop opens around a soft wave, suggesting clarity, stillness, and renewal.
why: The upper form gathers into one quiet point; the lower form settles into a gentle wave. A broad open space separates them so the mark stays light. Water gives the identity a sense of renewal and preparation for prayer.
risk: The water metaphor can also suggest wellness or a water service. The app name carries the specifically Islamic purpose.
reasonToChoose: You want calmness and renewal to lead the identity.

palette.name: SAFA / DEEP BLUE + PEARL + SEA GLASS
